Reading the map

Each crossing is a separate field-verification scenario. Distances follow the mapped sidewalk network at 1.2 m/s. Block counts represent occupied housing units in 2020. Households within a block share a modeled starting point. Stops reflect an inventory, and the study boundary limits available routes.
